adopted_source_edition.raw_sha_unavailable_reason: Existing G2 receipt did not acquire publisher PDF bytes; official complete Version-of-Record HTML was inspected. No byte hash was invented.

operator_source_descriptions.MEM-01:trace-creation-and-base-level-dec: Repeated encoding adds creation times/traces for a single declarative memory representation; trace availability decays by a power function and trace-specific decay can depend on activation at trace creation (Eq. 5). This is ACT-R declarative long-term memory state, not an experimenter-imposed retention interval.
operator_source_descriptions.MEM-01:contextual-spreading-activation: Current-context features provide weighted spreading activation S(m)=W/N sum_q S(q->m) (Eq. 6), changing retrieval activation; W indexes contextual attention/working-memory control rather than storage itself.
operator_source_descriptions.MEM-01:retrieval-competition-and-partial: Retrieval is selected from declarative memories under activation, cue constraints, similarity/mismatch and competition; the source explicitly distinguishes retrieval interference from encoding interference.
operator_source_descriptions.MEM-01:blended-reconstructive-retrieval: Blending returns feature values minimizing expected dissimilarity across candidate memories weighted by retrieval probability (Eq. 8), providing a reconstructive retrieval operator.

profiles.direct_ancestor_note: The paper explicitly analyzes an inherited ACT-R declarative-memory system developed over decades, but W3 did not pin an exhaustive paper-level DOI chain for that historical architecture. Books/non-DOI sources must not be converted into invented DOI ancestors.

source_loci: Springer Version of Record: base-level activation/traces Eqs. 3-5; spreading activation Eq. 6; blending Eq. 8; encoding/retrieval neurobiology sections

adverse_source_limits: Integrative ACT-R framework paper, not evidence that all constituent mechanisms are newly introduced here.
ACT-R does not commit to a precise temporal-versus-interference biological mechanism underlying the decay-rate parameter.
The source states there is no agreed ACT-R mechanism for interference during encoding; retrieval interference is handled separately.
Neurobiological mappings are proposed interpretations of ACT-R operators and are not direct biological measurements of those operators.
Publisher PDF raw bytes were not frozen by the existing G2 receipt.

operator_source_descriptions.MEM-02:semantic-generative-model: A learned latent-variable generative model of environmental statistics is assigned to semantic memory and supplies the decoder/prior used to reconstruct compressed episodes.
operator_source_descriptions.MEM-02:beta-vae-rate-distortion-encoding: A beta-VAE approximate posterior q_phi(z|x), generative likelihood p_theta(x|z), and prior p_theta(z) instantiate a rate-distortion trade-off; beta scales the information/capacity regularization.
operator_source_descriptions.MEM-02:latent-posterior-reconstruction: Episode-specific information is represented through latent z and reconstructed through the learned decoder, producing gist/prototype-biased recall under compression.
operator_source_descriptions.MEM-02:delay-indexed-compression-variant: Delayed forgetting is represented by moving toward lower rate/higher beta; in the experiments separate models/compression settings are used for levels of delay rather than a demonstrated within-trace biological consolidation operator.

profiles.direct_ancestor_note: The source explicitly builds on beta-VAE and information-bottleneck/rate-distortion work, but the cited foundational beta-VAE/IB items used for this lineage are conference works without a source-pinned DOI here; W3 does not fabricate DOI identifiers.

source_loci: PLOS theoretical framework: rate-distortion theory, VAE/beta-VAE, information bottleneck; Materials and Methods model architectures; delayed-forgetting analysis

adverse_source_limits: The work targets qualitative memory phenomena; several hyperparameters are chosen to place reconstructions in an experimentally comparable regime rather than uniquely fit a biological mechanism.
For delayed recall, forgetting is modeled with separate compression levels/models; this does not establish a biological storage or consolidation update acting on one persisting trace.
The paper notes that converting a lower-beta representation to a higher-beta representation is not guaranteed when required information has already been lost.
Delay-to-beta mapping is a model calibration/interpretive bridge, not a measured neural variable.

operator_source_descriptions.MEM-03:population-superposition-storage: Multiple simultaneously presented visual items are overlaid in a shared population activity state; the model is a restricted palimpsest and does not model indefinite sequential overwriting.
operator_source_descriptions.MEM-03:noisy-population-state: The final memory population is a noisy combination of item-evoked population responses; representational precision depends on population code and noise.
operator_source_descriptions.MEM-03:cue-conditioned-bayesian-recall: Given a cue to one feature, recall samples/infers the posterior for the target feature from the final noisy population state; apparent guessing arises from posterior uncertainty rather than a separate random-guess state.
operator_source_descriptions.MEM-03:mixed-vs-hierarchical-code-varian: The source compares mixed/conjunctive and hierarchical population coding organizations and analyzes binding/fidelity consequences.

profiles.direct_ancestor_note: Population-coding and Bayesian-recall predecessors are discussed, but no single source-explicit paper-level DOI was frozen by W3 as a direct ancestor of the full palimpsest model.

source_loci: PLOS main model and Methods; Supporting Information declaration for additional derivations

additional_edition_bundle.blocker: Existing G2 repository receipt does not freeze raw S1 Text bytes; S1 contains additional derivations including large-population Fisher-information and fidelity relations.

adverse_source_limits: The model is deliberately simplified/exploratory and does not by itself establish a measured biological storage implementation.
The central store is an overlaid population representation; behavioral short-term-memory effects must not be relabeled as a generic computational storage operator.
The paper's S1 Text contains model-relevant derivations not frozen by raw SHA in the current repository evidence, so full mathematical-variant closure is blocked.

operator_source_descriptions.PRD-02:reward-structure-belief-state: The Bayesian RL state includes uncertainty over reward probabilities and a hidden binary coupling structure (independent versus coupled reward generation).
operator_source_descriptions.PRD-02:bayesian-reward-and-structure-upd: Observed reward histories update posterior probability over reward parameters and coupling structure; structure uncertainty gates how evidence transfers between options.
operator_source_descriptions.PRD-02:belief-state-optimal-action-selec: Actions are valued from the belief state under Bayesian reinforcement learning, balancing information gathering/exploration with reward rather than applying a fixed predictive-coding error rule.
operator_source_descriptions.PRD-02:fixed-structure-and-q-learning-co: Fixed independent, fixed coupled, and model-free Q-learning/softmax are explicit comparison variants, not components to merge into the central structure-learning model.

profiles.direct_ancestor_note: The source extends Bayesian reinforcement-learning and graphical-structure-learning traditions, but its cited foundational BRL sources are conference/book works in the source record; no DOI-only direct ancestor is asserted.

source_loci: PLOS Structure learning model with Bayesian reinforcement learning; graphical reward-generation models; belief-state action selection; model comparison; Methods

adverse_source_limits: The task's independent/coupled reward-generation alternatives are experimenter-defined candidate structures; they are not evidence of a universal internal generative model.
The authors explicitly ignore dependencies across trials and note that reward-structure learning ultimately must be integrated with temporal-dependency learning.
A nontrivial subset of choices is not captured by the compared models; behavioral fit does not establish a neural implementation.
Q-learning with softmax is a comparator and must not be treated as the paper's source-native central family.

operator_source_descriptions.PRD-03:hidden-trial-state-transition: A Hidden Markov Model represents latent trial type and the experiment-defined cyclic transition structure across lead/test/trail states.
operator_source_descriptions.PRD-03:observation-likelihood-integratio: Frequency and price observations supply likelihood evidence for latent trial state and are integrated with prior/past-state evidence.
operator_source_descriptions.PRD-03:past-evidence-uncertainty-gate: Intermediate matrix B, parameterized by gamma, degrades use of past evidence: gamma=0 preserves past-state determination and gamma=1 ignores past information.
operator_source_descriptions.PRD-03:posterior-response-likelihood: Posterior state certainty is mapped to observed response likelihood for fitting; gamma and observation-noise sigma are estimated across training tertiles.

profiles.direct_ancestor_note: The source uses the HMM formalism and cognitive-map background but W3 found no source-explicit DOI-level direct ancestor for this exact task model.

source_loci: PLOS HMM model, intermediate B/gamma uncertainty matrix, alternative model comparison, Eqs. 5-8 parameter-fit methods; S1-S4 figure declarations

adverse_source_limits: The latent transition structure is experiment-defined; the fitted HMM describes subjects' inference within that world and is not itself evidence that the transition structure was neurally learned by the same operator.
The paper does not model initial acquisition of the overall world-model structure; changes in gamma characterize improved use of past evidence.
Gamma and sigma can be moderately anticorrelated, limiting unique mechanistic interpretation.
A more complex asymmetric B variant helps some subjects but is not adopted as the average central model.

operator_source_descriptions.SKL-01:synergy-factorized-forward-map: The body-machine mapping C is factorized as W Phi using participant-derived motor synergies, providing a lower-dimensional learned representation of a high-dimensional motor mapping.
operator_source_descriptions.SKL-01:perceptual-recency-dynamics: A continuous-feedback perception model filters recent joint-motion information before forward/inverse learning; this is an internal perceptual state, distinct from the externally imposed target task.
operator_source_descriptions.SKL-01:forward-error-gradient-update: The forward mapping estimate is updated by gradient descent on a forward/sensory-prediction error with forward learning rate gamma.
operator_source_descriptions.SKL-01:inverse-control-gradient-update-w: Nominal joint velocity is updated by gradient descent on a cost combining target/task error and control energy, with exploratory noise; the paper interprets this as de-novo controller acquisition rather than mere motor adaptation.

profiles.direct_ancestor_note: The source states that its forward/inverse formulation follows Pierella et al. 2019 and that removing the perception model and task-error regularization exactly recovers that episodic model; it also states the convention was originally introduced by Jordan & Rumelhart 1992.

source_loci: PLOS Model Eqs. 6-9; HML parameter discussion; explicit Pierella/Jordan-Rumelhart lineage; Supporting S1 declaration

additional_edition_bundle.blocker: S1 contains supplementary HML model details and convergence analysis; existing G2 receipt freezes only the main PDF.

adverse_source_limits: The model is a fitted/normative computational account; human behavioral trajectories do not directly measure forward-map or inverse-controller neural states.
The paper explicitly cautions that forward/inverse coevolution is well established in adaptation but generalization to de-novo skill learning requires care.
Motor synergies are a representation/factorization choice and must not be confused with the externally imposed target-capture task.
S1 contains model details and convergence proofs not raw-frozen in the current repository evidence, so full mathematical closure is blocked.

operator_source_descriptions.SKL-02:sorn-recurrent-state-transition: Sparse recurrent excitatory/inhibitory threshold units form a SORN reservoir whose activity state is driven by sequence-specific external input.
operator_source_descriptions.SKL-02:stdp-recurrent-weight-update: Temporally asymmetric STDP modifies recurrent excitatory connections and supports learned sequence-specific trajectories.
operator_source_descriptions.SKL-02:intrinsic-plasticity-threshold-up: Intrinsic plasticity changes excitability/thresholds to regulate firing statistics; it is a distinct homeostatic mechanism from STDP.
operator_source_descriptions.SKL-02:synaptic-normalization: Incoming recurrent weights are normalized, stabilizing the adaptive reservoir jointly with intrinsic plasticity.
operator_source_descriptions.SKL-02:supervised-motor-readout: A separate motor/output layer is trained from reservoir states; the human motor task is an imposed simulation mapping and must not be conflated with a biological inverse controller.

profiles.direct_ancestor_note: The paper explicitly identifies its architecture as belonging to the SORN family and cites the original SORN paper by Lazar, Pipa & Triesch (2009).

source_loci: PLOS Methods: SORN network architecture and plasticity; Results sequence-learning simulations; Supporting S1-S6 parameter-sensitivity figures

adverse_source_limits: The SORN is a computational neural-network model fitted qualitatively to multiple human sequence-learning experiments; it is not a direct measurement of synaptic STDP/IP/SN in those participants.
The task-specific motor output/readout is supervised and externally defined; the recurrent network should not be mislabeled as an endogenous inverse motor model.
Interference/facilitation emerge from the inherited SORN plasticity architecture; they are not evidence that the paper independently invented the SORN family.

operator_source_descriptions.SKL-03:last-success-aim-cache: The model retains a single intended aim associated with the most recent successful reach rather than a full action-value/reinforcement landscape representation.
operator_source_descriptions.SKL-03:reinforcement-gated-aim-update: After success, intended aim moves by proportion alpha toward the successful reach; after failure, intended aim is retained rather than directly shifted.
operator_source_descriptions.SKL-03:outcome-dependent-exploration-var: Trial movement variance combines motor/execution variance and an added exploratory component after unsuccessful outcomes.
operator_source_descriptions.SKL-03:local-reinforcement-landscape-sam: Movement variability samples a spatially local region of the continuous action space; learning uses temporally recent local reward information and does not construct a global expected-value table.

profiles.direct_ancestor_note: The source says Pekny et al. 2015 provided motivation for outcome-dependent variability and that the resulting formulation is similar to Therrien et al. 2018, while explicitly distinguishing its aim-update rule. Haith & Krakauer 2014 is also named as a motivating MCMC model but the cited conference item has no source-pinned DOI, so no DOI is invented for it.

source_loci: PLOS Learning model Eq. 1 and best-fit parameter section; discussion of Haith/Krakauer, Pekny, Therrien lineage; Supporting S2/S3 Data declarations

additional_edition_bundle.blocker: S2 Data contains trial-by-trial motor/exploratory variability estimates used to initialize/model variance; raw bytes are not frozen in current G2 receipt.
S3 Data contains bootstrap best-fit parameter procedure/results; raw bytes are not frozen in current G2 receipt.

adverse_source_limits: The model is explicitly phenomenological and local: it requires a non-zero reward gradient within the range of natural movement variability and is limited to small workspace regions.
It caches one successful aim and uses local exploration; it does not learn or store a full reinforcement landscape.
The modeled intended aim is latent and fitted from behavior, not a directly measured neural state.
S2/S3 Data are part of the parameter-estimation chain and are not raw-frozen by the current repository receipt, so exact model-fit provenance remains blocked.
